title: Estimating the Best Treatment Combination Value in Sparse Quadratic Factorial Experiments
banked_reason: Sound original-record minimax bracket with matched sparse/dense ranges; sharp all-s frontier remains open. Independent validity gate confirms incremental below field, score ceiling 4.8 < 7.4; no bounded repair.
gap_reasons: The promised explicit all-s constant-factor frontier, attaining estimator, and iff consistency law remain open; the delivered bracket and matched endpoint/range results are a strictly weaker kernel.

Position the partial sharp-range consistency theorem against the accepted-bank scalar discrete optimal-value minimax frontier: name it and explain why its cellwise/additive functional and experiment neither subsume nor are subsumed by this cycle-coupled quadratic target.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 established an original-record B-lower/D-upper minimax bracket, exact single-edge and dense endpoints, and matched fixed-margin sparse/dense ranges with partial consistency criteria. D0.5 passed mathematics and attested citations, but the full all-s frontier and iff consistency law remained open; at s=k a k^2 versus k^2 log k gap persists. Independent validity review confirmed incremental below field with no bounded repair, so no Lean formalization was attempted.
tldr: The causal best-combination response in a balanced binary factorial experiment is governed by a maximum of quadratic interactions. For the note's restricted benchmark—full \(2^k\) treatment support, i.i.d. uniform allocation, a known \(1/2\) center, an identity link, and an \(\ell_1\)-bounded sparse pure-pair response surface—the proved original-record results give a total hybrid estimator with upper-bound dimension \(D(k,s)=s^2\log(1+k^3/s^2)\) and an all-procedure converse with lower-bracket dimension \(B(k,s)\). These imply general sufficient and necessary consistency conditions. They match, up to constants depending only on fixed margins, on the union \(s\le k^{1-\varepsilon}\) or \(s\ge\alpha_{\mathrm d}\binom{k}{2}\); the dimension there is \(J_{\varepsilon,\alpha_{\mathrm d}}\), with sparse branch \(s^2\log(1+k^2/s^2)\) and dense branch \(k^3\). Exact consistency holds on this union, including arbitrary branch switching. The sharp complete sparsity frontier within this restricted benchmark, and its necessary and sufficient consistency law, remain unresolved.
gap: The published factorial best-response aim lacks an inspected sharp all-s benchmark in this original-record restriction. Generic affine recovery has logarithmic sample inflation; sparse prediction and Gaussian absolute powers have different targets.
fill: Derive the numerical frontier and a total attaining rule, matching them with legal value-separated original-record alternatives. Convert the law into a worst-case factorial precision benchmark.
